adaptations.withheld: sacred or restricted dance: no teaching adaptations

feedback_rules.description: Distinguish between incorrect formation and expressive variation in mimicry; camera cannot assess ritual intent.

learning_units.description: Form the semicircle chorus around the altar and maintain formation while singing.
Perform mimetic gestures illustrating the narrative of the song.

prerequisites.description: Ability to stand and move lightly in formation.

social_formats.description: Group dance with chorus formation; roles include chorus singers and mimetic dancers; shared rhythm from choral song.

movement_profile.arms_and_hands: used for mimetic gestures illustrating the song
movement_profile.formation_and_space: chorus forms semicircle around altar; dancers perform within or in front

signature_moves.description: gestures that illustrate the narrative of the song
signature_moves.name: mimetic gesture

movement_profile.what_to_avoid: disrespecting the ritual context improper mimicry that distorts the song's meaning

music_profile.sound_description: The music features light, imitative rhythms in cretic meter, accompanied by cithara and flute, supporting choral singing with a playful and lively mood.
music_profile.vocal_style: choral singing with lyric, playful character

basic_steps: Form a semicircle chorus around the altar
Designated dancers perform mimetic gestures illustrating the song
Chorus sings and dances lightly around the altar
When resting, chorus holds semicircle with leaders at wings
Incorporate playful and comic gestures in rhythm with the song
teaching.formation: chorus around altar in semicircle; dancers intermixed or separate
teaching.level_notes: Beginners start with simple mimetic gestures and basic chorus formation; advanced dancers add playful and comic movements.
teaching.rhythm: lyric, light, imitative rhythms in cretic meter
